name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you learn that devotion to the Light begins with selfless help for ordinary people in need.
As a dwarf, you take this trial in Ironforge, your own capital, among the halls of your home city.
As an Alliance member, you see compassion, charity, and care for the vulnerable among the virtues upheld in cities like Ironforge.

faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a sacred trial for aspiring servants of the Light in Ironforge. You seek out and help someone of pure heart and noble motive before continuing your spiritual teachings.
faq.q: What is The Tome of Divinity quest?

faq.answer: John Turner is a hardworking man in Ironforge's outer ring, where he plies his trade. He works long hours away from his beloved wife to gather resources and feed and clothe orphans.
The mentor sends you to test your understanding of compassion and service. You learn to recognize noble intent, offer kindness, and guide those who labor quietly for others.
faq.q: Why does the mentor send you to find someone in need?

faq.answer: John Turner walks along Ironforge's outer ring as he goes about his demanding daily work for the orphanage.
faq.q: Where is John Turner located in Ironforge?

aliases: what happens after finding john turner
return to temple of the light
faq.answer: After hearing John Turner's plight, you return to the mentor in the temple. There, you reflect on what it means to follow the Light and prepare for the next step of your calling.
faq.q: What happens once you speak with John Turner?

aliases: what orphanage is john turner shouting about
faq.answer: When first approached, John Turner shouts about the Orphanage of Stormwind, then catches himself and apologizes. He works to provide food and clothing for the orphaned children who rely on charity.
faq.q: Why was John Turner shouting about an orphanage?

sections.body: Initiates of the Light stationed in Ironforge face a trial of compassion. Their mentor sends them into the dwarven city to find someone truly in need of aid. The search calls for discernment: you must recognize a pure heart, noble intent, and a real need for kindness. Humble service lies at the heart of this calling.
sections.title: A Lesson in Compassion

sections.body: In Ironforge's outer ring, a humble worker named John Turner plies his trade. Startled by your approach, he calls out about the Orphanage of Stormwind, then tells you why he works so hard. Separated from his beloved wife by long hours of toil, Turner labors so orphaned children can have clothes and food. Help him, then return to the temple to continue your journey in the Light.
sections.title: The Burden of John Turner

summary: At Ironforge's temple, an initiate seeks a lesson in the Light through service. Sent by a mentor into the outer ring, you search for someone with pure intent and a genuine need. There, John Turner shows how compassion and selfless work belong on the path of the Light.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
